title: TestATicksTerminalRefusalHoldsOnlyThatTick flakes under full-suite load
description:
During d9d's full local ./internal/reconcile/ run this test failed once under load: the run's terminal refusal read as a2 'wiped' instead of a1's boundary_violation, and a2 stayed in_progress — a teardown-ordering race in the linger/signal machinery. It passed 4/4 alone on the d9d branch and 2/2 alone at the base commit; a base full-suite comparison could not complete within 45m on the same shared host, so the flake is not tied to any diff. Nothing in .tick/issues/ names it. Worth a look before it costs another worker a verdict.
evidence: internal/reconcile/hold_test.go:93, observed under `go test -timeout 45m ./internal/reconcile/` on a loaded host; passes alone at base a2b4f8e and at 780d6be5
